model.engine: ESS acceleration v2 (integration/ess-converged 9f4a292); launch presets not promoted (PR #18 QA-FAIL)

cg.basis: Typical coupe. No ESS measurement. —  Indicative range 18–22.

frontTrack.basis: Mike Mueller, The Complete Book of Ford Mustang (1993 LX V8 coupe)

rearTrack.basis: Mike Mueller, The Complete Book of Ford Mustang (1993 LX V8 coupe)

grip.basis: 1980s–90s performance radial (tire-type default; see acceleration validation).

cda.basis: Typical modern coupe/sedan Cd 0.30–0.36 × 22–24 ft². —  Indicative range 6.5–8.5.

frontSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.3 Hz front ride frequency (car).

rearSpring.basis: Spring giving a typical 1.45 Hz rear ride frequency (car).

frontMotion.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.85–1.

rearMotion.basis: Live axle, triangulated four-link (angled uppers). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 0.9–1.

frontUnsprung.basis: MacPherson strut (incl. modified strut, coil on lower arm). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 70–100.

rearUnsprung.basis: Live axle, triangulated four-link (angled uppers). Typical ranges for the architecture; motion ratio = spring travel ÷ wheel travel. Unsprung = per corner incl. wheel, tire, brake, half the links (live axle: half the axle). —  Indicative range 110–160.

tireRate.basis: Typical tire vertical rate for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 1000–2400.

weight.basis: Mike Mueller, The Complete Book of Ford Mustang (1993 LX V8 coupe)

front.basis: Layout class "fr-small": 7 front-engine cars under 300 lb-ft. —  Indicative range 0.49–0.541.

wheelbase.basis: Mike Mueller, The Complete Book of Ford Mustang (1993 LX V8 coupe)

hp.basis: 1993 Mustang Special Service Package factory data

hpRpm.basis: 1993 Mustang Special Service Package factory data

torque.basis: 1993 Mustang Special Service Package factory data

torqueRpm.basis: 1993 Mustang Special Service Package factory data

redline.basis: Peak-power rpm × 1.067 (Supercar X archive median, 64 cars; range ×1.00–1.16). —  Indicative range 4200–4850.

gears.basis: LMR, Mustang T5 transmission specs — Borg-Warner T5 World Class, 5.0 Mustang (1985–93). 1990–93 5.0 used the World Class T5 3.35 gear set

finalDrive.basis: 5.0 with World Class T5: 2.73 standard, 3.08 optional; default 2.73 until the axle tag is known.

diameter.basis: No tire size on record: typical diameter for the vehicle type. —  Indicative range 24–31.

archFront.basis: Fox: modified MacPherson (coil on lower arm), four-link rear with angled upper arms.

archRear.basis: Fox: modified MacPherson (coil on lower arm), four-link rear with angled upper arms.

spring-rate.estimated: Static front share (%), Front spring (lb/in), Rear spring (lb/in), Front motion ratio, Rear motion ratio, Front unsprung (lb/corner), Rear unsprung (lb/corner), Tire vertical rate (lb/in)

quarter.estimated: Static front share (%), CG height (in), Upshift RPM (model shift point, not the rev limit), Final drive, Rear tire diameter (in), Launch grip coefficient, Drag area (ft²)

oval.estimated: Static front share (%), CG height (in), Upshift RPM (model shift point, not the rev limit), Final drive, Rear tire diameter (in), Launch grip coefficient, Drag area (ft²)
